summary: Reachability test of Expo tunnel + preview backend for VapePOS mobile app. 4/5 checks PASS. Only failure: QR PNG URL is intercepted by frontend SPA fallback and returns HTML instead of image/png.

integration_issues.flow: QR code delivery for Expo Go onboarding
integration_issues.issue: GET https://vape-register-1.preview.emergentagent.com/preview/expo-go-qr.png returns HTTP 200 but content-type=text/html; charset=utf-8 (68375 bytes) — frontend SPA index.html is served instead of the PNG. The actual PNG exists at /app/mobile/.preview/expo-go-qr.png but is not exposed by any route. iPhones scanning this URL will get HTML, not an image.

check_2_launch_asset_bundle.notes: Bundle served over tunnel; well above 10 MB requirement.

check_4_qr_png.root_cause: Frontend SPA returns index.html as a 200 fallback for any unknown path. No backend/static route exposes /app/mobile/.preview/expo-go-qr.png at the public URL /preview/expo-go-qr.png.

action_items: Expose /app/mobile/.preview/expo-go-qr.png at the public URL. Options: (a) copy the PNG into /app/frontend/public/preview/expo-go-qr.png so the frontend serves it as a static asset, OR (b) add a FastAPI route e.g. GET /api/preview/expo-go-qr.png returning FileResponse('/app/mobile/.preview/expo-go-qr.png', media_type='image/png') and update docs/UI pointing at /preview/expo-go-qr.png to use /api/preview/expo-go-qr.png.
critical_code_review_comments: SPA fallback serving HTML with HTTP 200 for missing static assets hides real 404s and breaks content-type-sensitive consumers (image fetches, native clients). Consider returning index.html only for navigation-mode requests (Accept: text/html) and 404 otherwise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo tunnel https://nvf9thc-anonymous-19000.exp.direct is healthy; iOS + Android manifests return exposdk:52.0.0 and the Hermes bundle (~12 MB) downloads in ~18s. Backend /api/stores/public returns Pouzauges + Chantonnay. Only remaining issue: QR PNG not served publicly — file exists at /app/mobile/.preview/expo-go-qr.png.
rca of the issue: The preview domain routes all non-API paths through the frontend SPA which returns index.html with HTTP 200 for unknown routes. /preview/expo-go-qr.png is not registered as a static asset in frontend/public and no backend route serves it, so the fallback kicks in and masks the 404 as a 200 HTML response.
